### Português

Para pagamento da taxa de inscrição de R$ 12,00, utilize a **chave PIX 11960499760** (Isabela Lopes) e envie o comprovante de pagamento com o nome completo do competidor para o email **[campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com]**(mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com)
Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa.

**Atualização (28/08/2025):** Atingimos o limite de competidores, todas as inscrições pagas serão direcionadas para a lista de espera.
Estas são as orientações para a lista de espera:
* Um competidor só é adicionado à lista de espera após o compartilhamento do comprovante de pagamento conforme orientado acima;
* Caso um competidor com inscrição já confirmada cancele sua inscrição, chamaremos o primeiro competidor da lista, na ordem de compartilhamento do comprovante, via e-mail. Este terá 48 horas para confirmar que ainda possui interesse. Caso não haja resposta, chamaremos o próximo da lista;
* Na ocasião de haver competidores da lista de espera que não consigam uma vaga para competir, o preço de inscrição será reembolsado integralmente após a competição, com contato via e-mail.

#### Utilização de imagem
Assim como em outras edições do Golden Square Shopping, há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte do shopping ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pelo shopping ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso.


### English:
To pay the registration fee of R$ 12.00, use the PIX key 11960499760 (Isabela Lopes) and send the receipt with the competitor's full name to the following email address [campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com)
This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com))** so your spot can be given to someone else.

**Update (28/08/2025):** We have reached the competitor limit, all paid registrations will go straight to the waiting list.
These are the guidelines for the Waiting List:
* A competitor is only added to the waiting list once the payment receipt has been shared as specified above;
* If a competitor with a confirmed registration cancels his registration, we will email the first competitor on the waiting list, in the order we receive the receipts. They will have 48 hours to confirm they are still interested. If there is no answer, we will email the next competitor on the list;
* If there are competitors on the waiting list who don't have the chance for a spot to compete, the price of the registration will be refunded entirely after the competition, through email contact.

#### Image use
As with previous editions of Golden Square Shopping, it's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by the mall or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by the shopping mall or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this.

Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubetecCEFETTimoteo2025/register). Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$20. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization.

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubetecCEFETTimoteo2025/register) tab. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*
​
#### **Deutsch:**
​
Speedcubing ist auch 2025 wieder zurück in Graz! Wir freuen uns wieder ein offizielles WCA Turnier in Graz zu veranstalten. 
​
Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber und Felix Strasser organisiert sowie von Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar delegiert. Die Competiton findet im Herzen von Graz am Campus Alte Technik der Technischen Universität Graz statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.
​
Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können, den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden, solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!
​
Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.
​
​
Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!
​
-----
​
#### **English:**
​
Speedcubing is back in Graz! We are happy to announce another WCA Competition in Graz. 
​
The Speedcubing Competition is organized by Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber and Felix Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. The competition will take place in the heart of Graz at the Campus Alte Technik of the Graz University of Technology. The results of this competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.
​
The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.
​
Every Competitor can bring one guest.

This Fewest Moves competition is part of CubingZA's South African National Championship for 2025, but is being hosted in several separate venues across the nation. Please see the **Locations** tab for more information.

Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event.

There will be a short break in between attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors.

**GUESTS**

Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

* If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time, please bring a valid proof of identity (**NIC/Passport/Postal ID/Driving License**)
If you still don't have any of the above mentioned identifications, bring a colour photograph of yourself certified by your school principal or a justice of peace.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session at 08:30 AM
